seoTitle: How to Exit Full Screen in TradingView Quickly
metaDescription: Learn how to exit full screen mode in TradingView using the toolbar button or keyboard shortcut, plus fixes if full screen won't close properly.
intro: Getting stuck in full screen mode on TradingView can be more disruptive than it seems, especially if you need to switch back to a normal view quickly. This guide covers the toolbar button method, a keyboard shortcut, and troubleshooting steps if full screen refuses to close. It's aimed at anyone who wants a fast, reliable way to toggle their chart view.

steps.heading: Use the full screen button toggle
steps.body: Click the full screen icon in the chart toolbar again to exit and return to the normal view.

steps.heading: Try the keyboard shortcut
steps.body: Use the designated keyboard shortcut to instantly leave full screen mode without needing to locate the toolbar button.

steps.heading: Fix full screen not closing
steps.body: If the chart remains stuck in full screen, try refreshing the page or checking a different browser tab or window to resolve the issue.

steps.heading: Switch between normal and full screen view as needed
steps.body: Toggle full screen on and off depending on whether you need maximum chart space or access to other panels like the watchlist.

steps.heading: Apply final tips for smoother chart navigation
steps.body: Familiarize yourself with both the button and shortcut methods so you have a backup if one doesn't respond as expected.

faq.question: Why won't my TradingView chart exit full screen?
faq.answer: This can sometimes happen due to a browser glitch, so refreshing the page or trying the keyboard shortcut usually resolves it.

faq.question: Is there a keyboard shortcut to toggle full screen?
faq.answer: Yes, TradingView typically has a dedicated shortcut to enter and exit full screen mode without using the toolbar.

faq.question: Does full screen mode work differently on mobile versus desktop?
faq.answer: Yes, the full screen experience and available exit methods can differ between the desktop site and mobile app.

faq.question: Will exiting full screen lose my chart settings?
faq.answer: No, toggling full screen mode only changes the view and doesn't affect your indicators, drawings, or other chart settings.
